methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals distributed capacity-building through local institutions, creating pathways for deep AI/tech skills outside traditional metro hubs if sustained beyond grant cycles.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without accompanying deep skills infrastructure suggests shallow adoption through workplace tools, widening the gap between platform users and capability creators as automation reshapes entry-level work.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA reinforces deep defense-tech AI concentration in the region, attracting specialized talent and capital that remains geographically sticky despite statewide workforce needs.

signals.title: U.S. Navy Deploys Artificial Intelligence System to Accelerate Columbia and Virginia Submarine Production - Army Recognition
signals.signal_reading: Navy AI deployment for submarine production in Hampton Roads demonstrates deep defense-industrial AI capability, but remains concentrated in specialized military applications rather than distributing digital fluency across the regional civilian workforce.

signals.title: Comcast, Appalachian Power continue wrangling over broadband expansion
signals.signal_reading: Ongoing broadband infrastructure disputes between Comcast and Appalachian Power in Southwest Virginia reveal that foundational digital access barriers persist, preventing both shallow and deep AI adoption from reaching economically vulnerable regions.
